description.narrative: IFC anticipates that the project would result in improved quality of connectivity for end-users by scaling up a cloud-based digital infrastructure monitoring and testing platform, potentially resulting in higher usage of online services by customers' end users. Furthermore, the project has the potential to create some direct jobs for working-age individuals by supporting the company's expansion, particularly in India and the Philippines. Beyond the Project outcomes, this investment could contribute to market creation from the increased digital infrastructure monitoring and testing services across the target emerging market countries via demonstration and replication channels. The company is scaling up an innovative product that offers a horizontally integrated service across multiple silos of digital services and combines synthetic tools with AI Correlation Engine. The successful expansion of the company could demonstrate the viability of this technological solution, thereby triggering replication across the market for digital infrastructure diagnostic services.

Mozark Pte. Ltd. (the Company) is a SaaS business which has developed a proprietary cloud-based platform that provides a non-intrusive approach to testing and monitoring the quality of digital infrastructure, from backend private infrastructure and telecom networks, to front end user applications performance and user experience. Mozark is seeking funding to scale up its operations via (i) incremental hiring across sales, marketing, and operations functions, (ii) incremental R&D investment in product enhancement and product development, (iii) strategic small size acquisitions and other runway expenditures as strategically required in the scale up phase.
